name: copilot-workspace
description: Setup and sync GitHub Copilot configuration from GravionLabs/copilot-hub. Provides an interactive wizard (gh-copilot-setup) to bootstrap .github/ with instructions, prompts, and agents tailored to your stack, plus a sync prompt (gh-copilot-sync) to keep them up to date. Includes create-agents-md to scaffold an AGENTS.md repository context file. Issue workflow skills (start-work-on-issue, implement-issue, finish-work-on-issue, work-on-issue) automate the full branch → implement → review → PR lifecycle. The standalone scripts (copilot-sync.ps1, New-AgentsMd.ps1) are included for manual or scheduled runs without the AI prompt.
